  • docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md — minimal update to reflect that Round 1 PostgreSQL logical schema design has been documented (proposed, not implemented) and to list the new logical design documents; no unrelated status changes.

Decisions preserved

  • Python backend; PostgreSQL primary relational database; modular monolith.
  • External AI SaaS providers only for MELIRA; no local LLM inference/local AI compute/local GPU; CARES core works without MELIRA.
  • Multi-tenant isolation at application and database boundaries; trusted verified transaction-bound tenant context (not client-supplied IDs or user-settable PostgreSQL GUC authorization); RLS defense in depth.
  • Logical database roles: cares_api_runtime, cares_ingest_runtime, cares_worker_runtime, cares_migration, cares_maintenance; no ordinary runtime role as owner/SUPERUSER/BYPASSRLS.
  • Asset licensing invariants (one unique monitored device = one licensed asset per tenant, no duplicate counting across sources, source not billable, equal device weight, licensing separate from technical quotas, IP/hostname not stable identity, no auto-merge on ambiguity, stable non-reusable canonical IDs, atomicity/durable idempotency support for identity/licensing/lifecycle/history).
  • Source-device identity model distinctions and constraints (asset, data_source, asset_data_source, stable source_device_key, source_device_fingerprint_alias, identity claims/observations; no competing source of truth for binding; aliases versioned lookup identities with overlap to same stable binding; no raw source identifiers as DB uniqueness keys).
  • ADR statuses preserved (including ADR 0006 Proposed).

Proposed design choices (logical, not accepted)

  • Explicit entity catalogue covering tenant/access, asset/identity/licensing, event ingestion/processing, audit/forensic evidence, MELIRA/AI configuration, and selected SOC entities supported by documented requirements.
  • Recommended (not approved) interpretation: asset_data_source and source_device_key modeled with a single authoritative stable-binding relationship (preferably 1:1 ownership) to avoid competing sources of truth; ambiguity recorded in open decisions.
  • Distinct modeling of event_receipt (ingestion idempotency) vs identity_operation_idempotency_ledger vs outbox attempt/replay metadata.
  • Separation of operational audit_event from forensic evidence metadata/object versions/custody records and controlled transition authorization.
  • Tenant ownership/data classification matrix with expected RLS applicability categories and tenant-inclusive FK enforcement requirement for physical schema.

Contradictions and ambiguities documented (not silently rewritten)

  • asset_data_source ↔ source_device_key cardinality/ownership remains ambiguous across reconciled materials; competing interpretations and recommended direction documented (OD-002).
  • Pending identity reservation/capacity accounting and active/reserved/pending/available/tombstone counter semantics remain unresolved and must not be double-counted (OD-003, OD-004).
  • ADR 0006 contains proposed semantics but remains Proposed with schema-level ambiguity (OD-001).
